biotools.summary: Pylluminator is a Python-based toolkit for Illumina methylation array analysis, providing pre-processing tools, quality control, differential methylation analysis, and visualizations. It is open-source and aims to provide a scalable and user-friendly alternative for methylation data processing.
biotools.name: Pylluminator
